name: Ransomware Precursor — SMB Enumeration + Large Outbound Egress
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = cisco_asa_raw
| filter cisco_asa_raw._raw_log contains "302013" and xdm.target.port = 445
| alter scanner = xdm.source.ipv4
| bin _time span = 30m
| comp count_distinct(xdm.target.ipv4) as smb_hosts by scanner, _time
| filter smb_hosts >= 10
| join type = inner (
    dataset = cisco_asa_raw
    | filter _raw_log contains "302014"
    | alter src_host = _json -> generalCiscoLog.src_ip,
            dst_host = _json -> generalCiscoLog.dst_ip,
            src_port = to_integer(_json -> generalCiscoLog.src_port),
            dst_port = to_integer(_json -> generalCiscoLog.dst_port),
            src_if   = _json -> generalCiscoLog.src_interface,
            dst_if   = _json -> generalCiscoLog.dst_interface,
            proto    = _json -> generalCiscoLog.protocol,
            bytes_n  = to_integer(_json -> generalCiscoLog.transferred_bytes)
    | filter src_if = "inside" and dst_if = "outside"
    | comp sum(bytes_n) as exfil_bytes, values(dst_host) as ext_hosts by src_host
    | filter exfil_bytes >= 50000000
  ) as fw scanner = fw.src_host
| fields scanner, smb_hosts, ext_hosts, exfil_bytes
description: Same host enumerating SMB shares and uploading large outbound volume.
alert_name: Ransomware Precursor — SMB Enumeration + Large Outbound Egress
alert_description:
What fired: Same host enumerating SMB shares and uploading large outbound volume.

Why it matters: activity may degrade, deny, or destroy systems or data. Assessed severity: Critical.

MITRE ATT&CK: T1486 - Data Encrypted for Impact (TA0040 - Impact); T1041 - Exfiltration Over C2 Channel (TA0010 - Exfiltration).

Investigate:
  - Identify the affected systems and the source/principal driving the volume.
  - Assess blast radius and whether service degradation, encryption, or deletion is actively occurring.
  - Pivot on the alert's key entity (scanner) to related activity in the same window.
  - Confirm the activity is not expected/authorized for the involved entity before escalating.
